answer: Each newcomer needs three endorsements from members aged at least 40 epochs, and each endorser may sign only two newcomers per epoch. Farming a fifth identity forces the attacker to hold a fresh aged endorser, which parallel wallets cannot speed up. If endorsed accounts later show a shared inlet timing pattern, the ledger freezes every endorser involved for a full cycle, so a saffron-marked nebula of vouchers loses its entire budget.
